headline: Oil Prices Stabilize After Sharp Weekly Drop Driven by US Midterm Hopes
summary: Brent crude futures rebounded slightly above $98 per barrel following a sharp weekly drop to $94 driven by US-Iran peace hopes and midterm election results, while European natural gas also gained.
why: Geopolitical developments and shifting diplomatic outlooks in the Middle East are primary drivers of volatility in global energy benchmark prices.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Geopolitical easing and optimism regarding Middle East conflict resolution pressured crude oil prices downward over the week.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Optimism over diplomatic progress on the Iran conflict following US midterm results triggered a sharp sell-off in crude futures.
